tree:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background for a 2D side-view fantasy platform game, wide 16:9 high resolution, richly painted.
The three input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: match their intricate dark-fantasy painting, natural material detail, cool blue-teal shadow and warm amber lamps, atmospheric depth, sophisticated medieval gothic architecture. Not cartoon, not flat vector, not cute rounded houses.
Create an ancient monumental tree growing through tall weathered rock formations, the foundation of a vertical lizard settlement called Drevograd. No text. A massive gnarly furrowed trunk occupies roughly x=56% to 65% of the image, extending from exposed roots at bottom to spreading canopy at top 15%. Thick organically branching limbs extend horizontally left and right around 34%, 52%, and 70% image height, with many smaller branches, hanging ivy, moss, a few suspended lanterns, distant narrow rope bridges BEHIND the play area. Root buttresses reach across the bottom. Frame the left and right edges with dramatic layered stone escarpments, glimmering waterfalls and distant gothic ruins. Deep twilight, warm golden light through canopy from upper right, distant sunset horizon in gaps, teal luminous mist, textured bark and finely painted fern leaves. The tree is an organic inhabited-world landmark, not a Christmas-tree silhouette or flat tiered diagram.
This is BACKGROUND scenery: leave generous open air in front of the tree for separately drawn houses and NPCs on three upper platforms and the root floor. NO foreground houses, no characters, no UI, no symbols, no text, no logos, no large obstructions in the play corridor. Rich cinematic environment art cohesive with reference images; highly detailed surface painting and believable natural shapes.
homes:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent architectural sprite atlas for a 2D side-view fantasy platformer.
All three input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Match the intricate painted dark fantasy game art: sharp organic timber grain, chipped ash-grey stone, moss, ivy, gothic leaded windows, aged brass, realistic slate shingles, warm amber interior illumination, cool teal-blue shadows. NOT cartoon, NOT flat vector, NOT simplified geometric icons, NOT round toy houses.
Create ONE atlas, exactly FOUR COLUMNS by THREE ROWS, twelve separate distinct architectural sprites, evenly sized cells. Landscape 4:3 composition. Each building shown straight-on FRONT ELEVATION, same side-view perspective, full structure uncropped including roof and foundations, isolated on actual transparent alpha background, no scenery backdrop and no ground shadow outside its own cell. Leave at least 8% transparent margins in every cell; never cross cell boundaries. Each building base aligned at 88% height of its cell. No grid lines or text.

platforms:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent platform texture atlas for a 2D side-scrolling dark fantasy game. Reference images supply only visual style: intricate hand-painted medieval fantasy, natural wood grain, chipped masonry, moss and ivy, cool blue-grey shadows and restrained amber highlights, realistic materials. Absolutely no flat vector/cartoon shapes.
Create exactly TWO COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, four separate wide horizontal platform sprites in equal cells on actual transparent alpha. Overall landscape aspect ratio 2:1. Each cell contains one long roughly 3:1 platform, front/side elevation with only a very thin visible top, zero perspective angle. The FLAT, STRAIGHT WALKABLE TOP SURFACE sits at exactly 30% down each cell. Extend platforms nearly edge to edge horizontally leaving 4% margin. Leave transparency above the platform (no plants or objects above the top), and below the dangling roots or supports. Never cross cell boundaries.
Top left: ancient massive horizontal oak bough reinforced with weathered wooden planks along a straight level top, thick branching roots and dark ivy hanging beneath.
Top right: medieval stone terrace with a straight level top of worn cobblestones, detailed basalt masonry side, fern roots and ivy hanging beneath.
Bottom left: narrow suspended bridge with worn timber planks along a straight level top, ropes and timber supports dangling BELOW the top; NO railings or vertical rope above top.
Bottom right: small craggy stone stepping ledge with straight level moss-edged walkable top, jagged stone below.
No people, buildings, lamps, text, grid lines, background scenery, UI or watermark. Preserve actual transparent background. Detailed painted natural edges; game-ready readable level walking surfaces.
